default.title: Uptown Waterloo - King Street North
default.content: A two-storey brick retail strip along King Street North, built in the early 1900s. Ground-floor shopfronts with large display windows, offices and apartments above, and canvas awnings over most of the frontages. Warm red brick with painted cornices.

default.title: Uptown Waterloo streetscape
default.content: Street trees, benches and patio seating line the sidewalk. Evening lighting is warm, from storefront windows and strings of bulbs over the patios.

cafe.title: Independent cafe, Uptown Waterloo
cafe.content: Single-storey corner cafe in a brick building. Large front windows, a hand-painted sign, two outdoor tables under a dark green awning, and planters either side of the door.

cafe.title: Cafe interior and frontage
cafe.content: Wood counter, exposed brick, warm pendant lighting. The frontage reads cosy rather than upscale, and the patio is busy from mid-morning.

clock tower.title: Kitchener City Hall clock tower
clock tower.content: A tall civic tower in pale stone and glass, standing well above the surrounding buildings, with a clock face near the top and a public square at its base.

market.title: Kitchener Market hall
market.content: A large two-storey market hall in brick and glass with a broad entrance canopy. Stalls spill onto the sidewalk on market days; banners hang from the facade.
